sentences.text:
Respon  Through: Mr. Amit Ahlawat, APP for Sta  Inspector Sandeep and SI Raje  Vasant Vihar  CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE GIRISH KATHPALIA  ORDER % 04.09.2025 1.
The accused/applicant seeks anticipatory bail in case FIR No.128/2013 of PS Vasant Vihar for offence under Section 420/467/468/471/ 120B/174A/34 IPC.

2. After addressing partly, learned counsel for accused/applicant seeks permission to withdraw this anticipatory bail application with liberty to raise same grounds as raised in the present application in the regular bail application after surrender.
3. Accordingly, the anticipatory bail application is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty as sought.
Pending application also stands disposed of.
